THIS SCENE'S PURPOSE WITHIN ISSUE 2 (scene 11 of 20; HARD — this is the scene's ASSIGNMENT, not background):
    WHAT KIND OF DEVELOPMENT THIS IS: INDEPENDENT — it happens because the world is already moving toward it, whatever the protagonist does. She can be present for it, resist it, or arrive late; she cannot make it not happen by choosing otherwise.
    WHAT THIS SCENE ACCOMPLISHES: The consequences of the hidden sacrifice begin manifesting.
    WHY IT FOLLOWS WHAT CAME BEFORE (OBSTRUCTION — the previous development got in the way): Julian denied it unconvincingly and nothing is proven — but the sacrifice behind the wish goes on being paid for.
    WHAT CHANGES BY THE END: The hidden sacrifice is visibly costing something, and no one can say what or whose.
    WHAT IT SETS UP: The hidden sacrifice is producing consequences nobody can attribute to anyone.
    COMING LATER, RESERVED FOR ITS OWN SCENE (do not deliver, name or pre-empt any of it here):
      – scene 12 [CONVERGENCE]: The PC discovers every miracle has a sacrifice — but cannot determine whose.

      – scene 14 [CONVERGENCE]: THE INQUIRY CONVENES, AND CLOSES IN ON JULIAN — a Chayr and two Dohkars formally open the inquiry into Lirael, held at The Open; under it the investigation turns toward Julian. The
    THE PLAYER HAS AN UNANSWERED DECISION AT SCENE 19 (expose what Julian did vs let the inquiry's judgement stand).
